routine.title: How Iceberg Fits Into Your Everyday Routine

items.title: Everything at a glance
items.text: Open Iceberg and instantly see where you stand with each student: your last conversation, key observations, current topics, agreed goals, and next steps. Instead of searching through notes or trying to remember the details, you're prepared in just a few minutes. You enter every conversation with confidence because everything you need is right in front of you.

items.title: Be fully present in every conversation
items.text: Iceberg guides you through learning and coaching conversations with carefully designed prompts—from the opening questions to goals, challenges, aspirations, and the next small step. Together, you create a personal affirmation and a meaningful image that help the student stay motivated and remember their own strengths. While you focus on listening, asking questions, and building trust, Iceberg transcribes the conversation in the background. That means you can be fully present instead of taking notes, organizing information, and documenting everything at the same time.

items.title: Follow-up that practically writes itself
items.text: After the conversation, Iceberg automatically summarizes the key points for you. Strengths, competencies, goals, challenges, and next steps are clearly organized and professionally written. Within minutes, you have a polished summary that can be sent directly to parents as an email—if needed, even in the family's preferred language.

items.title: Capture observations with ease
items.text: Between conversations, simply record quick observations as voice notes. Iceberg automatically links them to the right student, so they're ready whenever you need them. Instead of starting your next conversation with a blank page, you'll have authentic insights from everyday school life at your fingertips.

items.title: Expert guidance exactly when you need it
items.text: Sometimes you sense there's more beneath the surface. A student's behavior puzzles you. A conversation didn't go as planned. A child seems stuck. Iceberg supports you with evidence-based guidance on behavior, classroom management, relationship building, learning strategies, and parent communication. It helps you better understand challenging situations, discover new approaches, and confidently plan your next steps.

founder.name: Branka Rezan
founder.text: You're not alone. Many teachers experience learning conversations as stressful, time-consuming, and little more than another box to tick. But that's only the surface. When you learn to take these conversations deeper, they become one of the most powerful tools for making everyday school life easier.

iceberg.title: Why the Name Iceberg?
iceberg.text: We believe in the potential of every student, and we understand how demanding the teaching profession can be. We created Iceberg to put meaningful educational impact back at the heart of everyday school life. To us, education is about far more than grades and managing behavior—that's only the tip of the iceberg. Iceberg stands for having the courage to look beneath the surface: to discover each student's true strengths, concerns, and untapped potential, while also recognizing the incredible potential within you as a teacher.

features.title: Everything you need for meaningful conversations

items.title: Guided conversation flow
items.description: A structured framework guides you through every phase of the conversation – before, during, and after. You always know what to focus on and how to lead the dialogue, without relying on improvisation. This creates consistency and confidence in every interaction.

items.description: Conversations are recorded and transcribed in real time, capturing everything accurately in the background. You no longer need to split your attention between listening and taking notes. This allows you to stay fully present with the student.

items.title: Smart prompts & question suggestions
items.description: During the conversation, the app provides contextual prompts and “power questions” to guide you. These suggestions help you go deeper, stay on track, and handle different situations more effectively. Over time, this improves the quality of every conversation you lead.

items.title: AI-generated summaries
items.description: After each session, the app automatically generates a clear and structured summary. It highlights strengths, key discussion points, and agreed next steps. What used to take significant time is now done for you within minutes.

items.title: WOOP goal builder

methodology.title: Grounded in research. Built for teachers.

descriptions.text: Iceberg is built on John Hattie's Visible Learning research—the largest synthesis of educational studies ever conducted. Hattie shows that the teacher-student relationship has an effect size of d = 0.72, almost twice the average of all educational interventions.

The WOOP method (Wish, Outcome, Obstacle, Plan) by Professor Gabriele Oettingen provides the goal-setting framework. Unlike positive thinking alone, WOOP asks: what might get in the way? And what will you do if that happens?

The 5 Iceberg Levels make independence visible. From Deep Sea (close guidance) to Summit (fully independent), each competency has its own journey. Teachers can see more in a student than the student believes about themselves.

hero.title: Frequently Asked Questions
hero.description: Everything you need to know about Iceberg and how it works

questions.question: What is Iceberg?
questions.answer: Iceberg is a tool designed to help teachers lead structured, meaningful learning conversations. It supports every step of the process – from preparation, through the conversation itself, to follow-up and parent communication.

questions.question: Who is Iceberg for?
questions.answer: Iceberg is primarily built for teachers and tutors working with students of school age. It is also valuable for schools and educational organizations that want to improve the quality of learning conversations.

questions.question: How does Iceberg work?
questions.answer: Iceberg guides you through three phases: before, during, and after the conversation. It helps you prepare, supports you with prompts during the session, and automatically creates summaries and parent communication afterward.

questions.question: Do I need to prepare before each conversation?
questions.answer: Preparation is minimal. Before each session, you get a quick overview of previous conversations, notes, and progress – so you can walk in prepared in just a few minutes.

questions.question: Does Iceberg replace my way of teaching?
questions.answer: No. Iceberg enhances your existing approach by giving you structure and support. You stay in control of the conversation – the app simply helps you do it more effectively.

questions.question: Is the conversation recorded?
questions.answer: Yes, conversations are recorded and transcribed to support documentation. Audio data is processed securely and handled according to strict privacy standards.

questions.question: Is Iceberg GDPR compliant?
questions.answer: Yes. Iceberg is fully GDPR compliant. Audio is deleted immediately after transcription (Zero-Retention), and no student data is used for AI training. All data is stored on EU servers.

questions.question: Can parents access the app?
questions.answer: No, the app is designed for teachers. However, parents receive clear and structured summaries after each conversation, so they stay informed and involved.

questions.question: Can I use Iceberg in different languages?
questions.answer: Yes. Iceberg supports multilingual communication, especially when generating parent emails, making it easier to include families from different backgrounds.

questions.question: How does the free trial work?
questions.answer: You can start using Iceberg immediately without a credit card. The full feature set is available during the trial, so you can experience the complete workflow.

questions.question: What do I get with a licence?
questions.answer: A licence gives you access to unlimited conversations, student profiles, automatic summaries, parent communication, and additional educational content and support.

questions.question: Do I need school approval to use Iceberg?
questions.answer: Yes. Since the app processes sensitive data, a data processing agreement and parental consent are required before using it in a school environment.

questions.question: How long does it take to get started?
questions.answer: Getting started is quick. Once the setup and required approvals are complete, you can begin your first conversation immediately.

questions.question: Will this add more work to my day?
questions.answer: No – the goal is the opposite. Iceberg reduces administrative work and simplifies documentation, so you can focus more on the conversation itself.

questions.question: What makes Iceberg different from other tools?
questions.answer: Iceberg is not just a documentation tool. It combines structured guidance, real-time support, and automated follow-up to improve the quality of conversations – not just record them.
